sentence: In retail, the payoff grows out of combinations of AI applications rather than any single use
passage: [Cao et al. (2025), p. 1] "we first construct a validated measurement instrument based on grounded analysis of 6,519 AI-related documents from 37 retailers. We then apply fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis (fsQCA) to survey data from 140 executives" / "superior performance stems not from isolated AI uses but from synergistic combinations--particularly those involving customer service and cybersecurity--interacting with other functions."

gemini.note: The passage explicitly states that superior performance stems from synergistic combinations rather than isolated AI uses in the retail sector.
